dogecoin.text: At the same time, Dogecoin may quickly get back to headlines in case it manages to stay above the $0.50 level and moves closer to recent highs.
It’s a relatively bullish start to the day. #dogecoin  would need to avoid a fall back through the day’s pivot to bring $0.50 levels back into play, however.

Failure to move through the $0.3392 pivot would bring the 62% FIB of $0.2882 and the first major support level at $0.1990 into play.

Barring another extended sell-off, however, Dogecoin should steer clear of sub-$0.20 levels. The second major support level sits at $0.0677.
